subject: PO field mapping, invoice rhythm and pricing guardrails for Zephyr Bio
messages:
From: Sasha Ruiz <sasha.ruiz@procuremax.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Helen Park <helen.park@zephyrbio.com>, ProcureMax AP <ap@procuremax.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO field mapping + invoice rhythm (Zephyr Bio RFP)

Hi David —

Thanks for the call this morning. Zephyr's procurement team needs two items clarified before they can finalize the PO: a) the exact PO field we require for their ERP (they use Workday) so their AP can auto-match invoices, and b) the invoice cadence tied to their net terms.

Quick summary of the ask from Helen (CFO):
- PO must include the internal project code (Zephyr project ID) in the PO header (PO.header.project_code)
- Vendor remit and GST fields must map to their ledger (they will provide a mapping file)
- Preferred invoice cadence: monthly consolidated invoices per PO; they prefer Net-60 but will consider Net-45 if pricing accommodates it

They also wanted to know whether a multi-PO / per-entity split (Zephyr has three bill-to entities) is supported and whether early-pay discounts can be applied per-PO. I've attached their preliminary mapping file. Can you confirm Redwood's required PO field names and whether we can support monthly consolidated invoices with Net-45?

Attachments: Zephyr_PO_Preview.csv

Appreciate a quick confirmation — Helen hopes to lock in the contract this week.

Best,
Sasha Ruiz
Senior Sourcing Manager | ProcureMax
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Ruiz <sasha.ruiz@procuremax.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Helen Park <helen.park@zephyrbio.com>, ProcureMax AP <ap@procuremax.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO field mapping + invoice rhythm (Zephyr Bio RFP)

Thanks Sasha — quick answers and proposed options below. Looping Vanessa (billing) and Grace (revenue ops) to align on exception and pricing tradeoffs.

1) PO field names we support (for automated ERP matching):
- PO.number (string)
- PO.header.project_code (string) -> required for per-project billing; will be matched to invoice.item.project_code
- PO.ship_to.entity_code (string) -> maps to our billing entity selector
- PO.remit.party_id and PO.remit.tax_id (strings)
- PO.line[].sku and PO.line[].qty (standard)

We can accept multiple PO records per invoice (consolidated invoice) provided the AP file references each PO.number. For Workday auto-match we recommend the project_code in both PO and invoice lines.

2) Invoice cadence & net terms — options for Zephyr:
- Standard: Monthly consolidated invoice, Net-60 (no discount)
- Compromise: Monthly consolidated invoice, Net-45 with a 1.5% volume discount applied to billed usage (requires a signed amendment)
- Early-pay: Net-30 with a 2.5% early-pay discount (applies only if paid within 30 days)

Vanessa — can you confirm revenue recognition impact for the Net-45 option and whether we can model the 1.5% slab in the pricing matrix? Grace — any constraints on approving Net-45 as a standard exception for mid-market deals?

We'll attach our PO field mapping template and a simple pricing matrix showing suggested discounts by net term and committed MRR. If Helen prefers multi-entity invoices, we can split by bill-to entity but that increases AP effort on their side — consolidation is simpler for their treasury.

Thanks,
David Kim
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
(direct) 415-555-0132
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Sasha Ruiz <sasha.ruiz@procuremax.com>
Cc: Helen Park <helen.park@zephyrbio.com>, ProcureMax AP <ap@procuremax.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO field mapping + invoice rhythm (Zephyr Bio RFP)

David — I've reviewed the recognition and billing side. Short answers:
- We can model the 1.5% volume discount for Net-45 in the attached pricing matrix. No revenue recognition showstoppers but we need the PO per-entity to match the billed entity on our invoices.
- For monthly consolidated invoices that reference multiple POs, AP will need to include a PO reference column in their remittance (they already indicated they will).
- SKU packaging: to avoid split-line matching errors, we recommend they use our canonical SKU list (attached sku-packaging-guidelines.pdf). If they cannot, we'll ask for a nightly SFTP drop of line-level remittance mapping.

Grace — from policy perspective we can approve Net-45 with the 1.5% concession for a one-year committed volume (tiered discount only applies if usage >= 50k tokens/month average). If Zephyr wants Net-60, discount reverts to 0.

Sasha / Helen — next steps to get this to procurement: 1) We send the PO_Field_Mapping_Template.xlsx pre-filled with Redwood field names; 2) Helen confirms the preferred net term (Net-45 suggested); 3) We issue a small amendment capturing the 1.5% volume discount and the commit threshold; 4) Helen's AP returns a sample consolidated remittance file.

Attachments: PO_Field_Mapping_Template.xlsx, sku-packaging-guidelines.pdf, redwood-pricing-matrix-q3.xlsx

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Billing Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Helen Park <helen.park@zephyrbio.com>

Thanks all — this is very helpful. Quick confirmation from Zephyr treasury:

- We will supply the three entity mappings and a sample remittance file by end of day Friday.
- Please send the DocuSign amendment for the volume discount (we'll route to legal).

Sasha — can you coordinate the sample remittance and send to AP and Vanessa (cc'd)? Once we have the amended term and a signed PO we can issue the first consolidated invoice for July.
